name: robot-start-accepts-wake-armed-sleep
description: The lifecycle command recognizes a healthy wake-enabled app without opening Realtime.
given: A real Reachy Mini with the app installed and wake mode enabled
when: scripts/robot start stops any existing app and starts it again
then: The command exits successfully after the app reports presence=sleeping, connected=false, and no last_error
validates: Issue #12 deployment readiness preserves local wake-armed sleep and does not require a metered Realtime connection
